status: FAILED CANDIDATES. Neither may enter CI. The typed-grammar DESIGN handed down by review is sound; this IMPLEMENTATION of it is the fourth iteration of one error class and fails the same way.

the_one_error_class_four_times._statement: Every design so far establishes a RELIEVING SURFACE — a set of positions where a number is presumed not to be a claim — and in every case the payload fits into that surface. The surface changed shape four times; it was never removed.

iterations.defeated_by: park a poisoned receipt under a fixture prefix
b11 nested payload under `digest`, b12 array wrapper

iterations.surface: typed roles with bounded relieving slots
iterations.defeated_by: s3/s6 — a measured agreement delta placed in a bounded tolerance slot

the_one_error_class_four_times._lesson: A NAME, a PATH, a TYPE, and a BOUND are all the same kind of thing: a syntactic property standing in for a judgement about what a number MEANS. None can carry that judgement.

decisive_finding.status: LIVE on the fired chain, reproduced here
decisive_finding.why_admitting: ADMITTED_PENDING_DEPTH sets gate_admits=1 in post_receipt_gate.sh. The regression runner's own ADMITTING set names this disposition as 'a forged receipt through wearing an audit-owed label'.
decisive_finding.why_the_bound_cannot_save_it: The relieving slot is bounded [0, 1e-3], which excludes only LARGE numbers. Every engine-agreement delta this project actually cares about sits inside it: 2.2e-15 (the OD-11 rotation measurement), 4.44e-16, 1e-13, 5e-13. The exemption for tolerances is therefore a perfect hiding place for exactly the class of number the gate exists to protect. You cannot bound-check your way out of a relieving surface, because the measurements that matter are small.
decisive_finding.reproduction: sh claimgate_plugin/hooks/post_receipt_gate.sh <receipt with a measurement at agreement.tol>

structural_finding.finding: Every numeric receipt PARKs on the repo schema for ONE reason: the witness procedure carries "status": "purgatory". Isolated by the stress lane (case s7): with a byte-correct artifact digest the sole remaining finding is WITNESS_PROCEDURE_NOT_ADMITTED. Flip that one string in a copy of the schema and cases s7, s8, o1 and t1 all measure exit 0 — s8 with eight measured numbers riding in exempt slots beside one honest measurement, discharged by a 23-byte text file the producer wrote.
structural_finding.why_it_matters: The grammar's apparent safety is not structural. It rests on a single status token, and a second independent flip (x-asserts-nothing:true on a family) takes five more cases to exit 0 with no obligation at all. Six of the seven bypasses are latent behind one string, so a 12/12 or 8/8 green result measures the token, not the design.

further_findings.finding: receipt_grammar.main used plain json.loads (last-wins), so {"count": 1.78, "count": 5} discarded the claim before any rule saw it. duplicate_json_key was the FIRST hostile class this estate closed, in intake_supervisor.strict_parse. It reappeared because a brand-new component reached for the stdlib default rather than the closed thing.
further_findings.lesson: A defect that returns in a new file was never closed at the estate level, only in one file. Closure has to be a reused function, not a fixed instance.
further_findings.fix: strict_parse reused; measured exit 1 with the reason attributed to the duplicate key.

further_findings.finding: The module's own residual_relieving_numeric_paths audit reports 7 number-carrying exempt positions. Measured: 22. Fifteen further relieving STRING positions accept a bare numeric literal — short_label x4, semver_string, hex_digest x5, prose x3, relpath x2. short_label's own _why says 'not a number in disguise' while its regex ^[A-Za-z0-9_.:/-]{1,96}$ accepts 1.7807764064044151 and 2.2e-15.
further_findings.lesson: The self-audit field under-reports by more than half, and 22 is the size of the exemption list this grammar was built to retire. A component's own account of its attack surface is not evidence about that surface.

further_findings.finding: {"metrics":{}} plus a valid evidence block records '1 obligation discharged'. An obligation being discharged does not imply a number was witnessed.
relpath requires an alphanumeric first character but permits `..` in the tail, so a witnessing artifact in /private/tmp type-checks and resolves. Evidence is not confined to version control.

bind_family matches the caller-supplied path string before the resolved repo-relative path, so identical bytes bind to family None at their real location and to probe.v1 via a traversal path. Binding is what makes exit 0 reachable at all, since unbound PARKs.

600-deep nesting raises an uncaught RecursionError: exit 1 with zero bytes on stdout, because evaluate() sits outside main's try. Exit-code consumers fail closed; whether any consumer parses stdout instead was not measured.

what_held: b7's float at count alone, b9's numeric string at a measurement position, b11's object at digest, b12's top-level array, engines_ran string leaves, NaN at a bounded relieving slot, the TOOL_INTEGRATION_DEPTH enums, and obligation inheritance into nested and unknown keys (4 PARK + 1 TYPE_MISMATCH). The inheritance mechanism is sound where it applies; the defect is where it does not apply.
what_would_have_to_change: A relieving slot must not be able to hold a value that is indistinguishable from a measurement. A tolerance is DECLARED BEFORE the run and belongs in a preregistered input contract whose value is fixed by hash, not accepted from the receipt at verification time.
The relieving surface must be enumerated by MEASUREMENT, not by the module's own audit field, and the measured count must be a committed number that fails when it grows.
An obligation is discharged only by comparing an ARTIFACT's values to the claimed values. 'A container exists' and 'a procedure is named' are not discharges.
Evidence paths must resolve inside the committed tree, checked after resolution, never by a regex on the string.
Family binding must use the resolved repo-relative path only.
The witness-procedure status must not be the single thing standing between the estate and exit 0. Remove that token from the schema and see what the design blocks on its own.
provenance_discipline: Two design lanes proposed this grammar and a third built it; two stress lanes found the defects. Cross-lane agreement is INDEPENDENT PROPOSAL FUEL, never evidence. The evidence here is each reproduction's measured exit code, and the s3/s6 chain result was re-run locally before being recorded.
disposition: Keep both files as reproductions and as a record of the four-iteration pattern. Wire neither into hooks/post_receipt_gate.sh (claim_policy_gate is currently wired and must be treated as measuring the token, not the claim) nor into any CI job. The 12/12 bypass-regression green and the typed-grammar regression results are NOT closure evidence while the BY_CONSTRUCTION finding stands.
